Values.Title: Intraday NAV (IIV)
Values.TooltipText: IIV is an abbreviation for the intraday indicative value of an ETF's Shares, and is disseminated every 15 seconds during regular trading hours. The IIV is based on the current market value of the securities and/or cash required to be deposited in exchange for a Creation Unit. Therefore, the IIV should not be viewed as a "real-time" update of the Fund's NAV, which is computed only once a day. The Fund is not involved in, or responsible for, the calculation or dissemination of the IIV and makes no warranty as to its accuracy.

Values.Title: Options
Values.TooltipText: VanEck has no influence, control or authority over option contracts issued on its ETFs. Options trading is subject to the rules and regulations of the exchange(s) on which such options trade.

Values.Title: 30-Day SEC Yield
Values.TooltipText: 30-Day SEC Yield is a standard yield calculation developed by the Securities and Exchange Commission that allows for fairer comparisons among funds. It is based on the most recent 30-day period. This yield figure reflects the interest earned during the period after deducting the Fund's expenses for the period. It does not reflect the yield an investor would have received if they had held the Fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV.
